name: run_github
description: Run the installed GitHub CLI with its existing github.com Keychain login through a localhost credential proxy. The real token stays outside the sandbox. Read operations and ordinary issue/PR development writes are allowed; unknown and destructive operations require local one-time approval_reason. No auth export, login changes, extensions, host overrides, editor or browser launches. Files remain read-only within approved scope. pr create requires explicit --head, --title and --body/--body-file and does not implicitly push. Simple top-level gh commands in run_shell are also forwarded; use this tool for composed shell commands. For authenticated branch pushes use args git, push, origin, HEAD:refs/heads/my-branch. Git pushes use an isolated configuration with hooks disabled, a configured HTTPS github.com remote, and explicit branch refspecs; no upstream/tracking config changes. Force/deletion/protected-name pushes require local approval.

name: managed_servers
description: Discover existing agents-dev configurations or Smithery connections. Returns names and status, never stored credentials. Default agents scope is ~/.agents; an optional project must already have file approval. Smithery uses its existing local login and namespace.

project.description: Optional approved project directory for agents-dev

name: request_managed_server
description: Ask the person at this Mac to forward one existing agents-dev or Smithery server until disconnect. Local stdio servers stay inside the file sandbox with network access. Managed HTTP services and Smithery use their existing service permissions and explicitly approved configured credentials. Does not install servers, change manager settings, or initiate OAuth. Use call_server_tool and stop_server with the returned id. Denial must not be retried automatically.

name.description: Exact managed server name or Smithery connection id from managed_servers

reason.description: Why this existing connection is needed

name: request_remote_server
description: Ask the local user to connect to a public HTTPS MCP endpoint. Prefers July 2026, supports legacy fallback. No local files or credentials are shared automatically. Tool arguments go to the approved service. No account authentication or private-network endpoints supported.

url.description: Public HTTPS MCP URL without credentials or query parameters

name: request_server
description: Ask the local user to run an exact-version npm MCP package without global installation. Install scripts disabled; high/critical audit failures blocked. Runtime network blocked, files limited to the current approved scope. Supports July 2026 discovery with legacy fallback. Use registry discovery to find packages first. Only Node.js packages with one executable supported.

name: active_servers
description: List session providers, ids and tool schemas.

name: call_server_tool
description: Call a tool from an approved session provider. It can modify files within its approved sandbox.

name: stop_server
description: Stop a session provider and delete its temporary working data.

name: request_computer_control
description: Ask the person at this Mac for full interactive screen control until disconnect. This capability can access apps and files beyond the file sandbox. Denial must not be repeatedly prompted.

name: computer_action
description: Call a Peekaboo tool only after local screen-control approval. Get tool schemas from request_computer_control. All drag actions require source and target element selectors; coordinates are forbidden.

name: request_access
description: Ask the person at this Mac to approve access to a specific existing file or folder. Only their decision can grant access. Access lasts until disconnect. Never repeat a denied request automatically.

path.description: Absolute path or ~/path of the existing file or folder

reason.description: Brief user-facing explanation of why access is needed

name: allowed_locations
description: List approved locations for this connection.

name: read_file
description: Read up to 1 MiB from an approved file. If denied, decide whether to use request_access.

name: write_file
description: Create or replace a file within approved read/write locations.

name: run_shell
description: Run ordinary development commands with network access, installed tools, writable development caches and approved project files. Known destructive commands are screened before execution. If flagged, a configured decision model may approve or reject it; uncertain decisions require local one-time approval via approval_reason; file permissions still apply. Do not use terminal apps to bypass a denial. Default timeout 30 seconds; timeout_seconds can extend it to 300.

task_context.description: Optional current task context for the reviewer; treated as agent-provided evidence, not human authorization

approval_reason.description: Optional reason to request local approval for this exact flagged command

timeout_seconds.description: Optional command timeout; extend MCP client timeout accordingly
